source.description:
Zeng Shaozong Portrait with Sculpture

Actor Zeng Shaozong appears in a minimalist indoor portrait, leaning beside a white classical bust sculpture. He wears a light gray checked blazer over a white shirt, and his thoughtful gaze meets the camera under soft, neutral lighting. The clean background emphasizes both his presence and the sculpture’s detailed contours.

This photograph was featured in a Yahoo Autos article titled “才進軍日本⋯疫情卡在台灣 　曾少宗：我很幸運了,” which covers Zeng Shaozong’s expansion into the Japanese entertainment market and how the COVID-19 pandemic has affected his work in Taiwan. The image credit goes to 幸星娛樂.

Zeng Shaozong’s Reflective Portrait

Zeng Shaozong stands in a lush, plant‑filled setting wearing a green button‑down shirt dotted with small light motifs. The hanging vines and surrounding leaves create a serene, almost secret garden atmosphere, while soft natural light illuminates his composed expression.

This image accompanies an article revisiting the breakup of the early 2000s Taiwanese boy band Comic Boyz. Zeng Shaozong’s Casual Selfie

Zeng Shaozong, once part of the early-2000s boy band Comic Boyz, shares a relaxed selfie from his home. Dressed in a denim shirt layered over a gray T‑shirt, he props his head on his hand and gazes thoughtfully into the camera. Behind him, a bookshelf and ceiling fan hint at a cozy interior setting.
